from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Basic identifying information from one legal document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or document type name")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number as written in the document")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The court that issued the document")

class PartyInformation(BaseModel):
    """Named parties in the legal document and their roles."""
    party_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of a party in the case")
    party_role: str | None = Field(description="Role of the party — plaintiff, defendant, appellant, respondent, etc.")
    party_relationship: str | None = Field(description="Relationship context — e.g. '上诉人与被上诉人', '申请人与被申请人'")

class JudgmentOutcome(BaseModel):
    """The key outcome/decision information from one legal document."""
    decision_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of decision — 驳回上诉, 维持原判, 撤销判决, 驳回申请, etc.")
    appealed_case_number: str | None = Field(description="The original/first instance case number being appealed, if mentioned")
    payment_details: str | None = Field(description="Any payment/compensation amounts ordered, if any")
    cost_allocation: str | None = Field(description="Who bears court costs/fees, as stated")
    is_final_judgment: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is stated as a final/终审 judgment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_identifiers: list[DocumentIdentifier]
    party_information: list[PartyInformation]
    judgment_outcomes: list[JudgmentOutcome]
